updates.name: SteamOS 3.8.25 Beta
updates.affects: Steam client / SteamOS / Steam Deck / game library / downloads / compatibility layers
updates.verdict: Use the stable channel unless you need these fixes for testing; this build has an acknowledged performance regression.
updates.reasoning: This SteamOS build is explicitly marked Beta/Preview by Valve. PatchTicker separates its acknowledged issues from the full change list so stable-channel users can avoid treating a test build as a routine update.
changelog: This update is for the SteamOS Beta and Preview channels, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel.
General: Added support for waking up from the Steam Controller Wireless Adapter (2015)
Steam Machine Firmware 108: Fixed an issue where the system could occasionally wake up immediately after going to sleep
Audio: Fix for HDMI audio dropouts with some game and TV combinations
Non-Valve Devices: Improve support for MSI Claw and OneXPlayer device variants
Developer: Updated the Linux kernel to 6.18.42
General: Improved battery indications when the device is charging in but using more power than the charger can provide
Steam Machine Firmware 108: Fixed a rare issue where CPU performance could be degraded until reboot after waking up from sleep
Audio: Improve reliability of HDMI hotplug detection
Non-Valve Devices: Improve support for devices with external or no Wi-Fi adapters
General: Preliminary support for the Steam Frame Wireless Adapter
Audio: Add option to prefer lower latency audio codecs for Bluetooth devices
knownIssues: There is a known issue with degraded performance in some cases when composition is required (such as when having FSR enabled). This issue is fixed in the latest SteamOS stable release (3.8.16). Affected users may wish to switch to the stable update channel while we work on bringing this fix to the beta channel.
